title: Bild AI (YC W25) Is Hiring a Founding Product Engineer
title_zh: Bild AI（YC W25）招聘创始产品工程师

paragraphs.en: AI estimating & detailing for Division 8 doors, frames & hardware
paragraphs.zh: 第8分部门、门框及五金的AI估算与详图设计

paragraphs.en: We founded Bild AI to tackle the mess that is blueprint reading, cost estimation, and permit applications in construction. It's a tough technical problem that requires the newest CV and AI approaches, and we’re impact-driven to make it more efficient to build more houses, hospitals, and schools. Featured on Business Insider .
paragraphs.zh: 我们创立 Bild AI，是为了解决建筑行业中图纸识读、成本估算和许可申请的混乱现状。 这是一个艰难的技术问题，需要最新的计算机视觉和 AI 方法，我们以影响力为驱动，致力于让建造更多房屋、医院和学校变得更加高效。 曾获 Business Insider 报道。

sents.en: We founded Bild AI to tackle the mess that is blueprint reading, cost estimation, and permit applications in construction.
sents.zh: 我们创立 Bild AI，是为了解决建筑行业中图纸识读、成本估算和许可申请的混乱现状。

sents.en: It's a tough technical problem that requires the newest CV and AI approaches, and we’re impact-driven to make it more efficient to build more houses, hospitals, and schools.
sents.zh: 这是一个艰难的技术问题，需要最新的计算机视觉和 AI 方法，我们以影响力为驱动，致力于让建造更多房屋、医院和学校变得更加高效。
曾获 Business Insider 报道。

paragraphs.en: Own features end-to-end — interview customers every week and watch them use the product, and ship the feature they need by the next week
paragraphs.zh: 端到端地负责功能——每周访谈客户并观察他们使用产品，在下周之前交付他们所需的功能

paragraphs.en: Build UIs that make complex blueprint and hardware data feel simple for people who've been doing this on paper for 20 years
paragraphs.zh: 构建让复杂的蓝图和硬件数据对那些已经用纸面方式工作了20年的人来说显得简单易用的用户界面

paragraphs.en: Work across the stack: React frontend, Python backend + infra
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖全栈工作：React 前端、Python 后端 + 基础设施

paragraphs.en: Shape what we build next, not just how we build it
paragraphs.zh: 塑造我们接下来要构建什么，而不仅仅是我们如何构建

paragraphs.en: Great product taste — you care about how things look, feel, and work for the user
paragraphs.zh: 出色的产品品味——你关注产品在用户眼中的外观、手感与使用体验

paragraphs.en: 0-to-1 architect and builder who can work across the entire stack
paragraphs.zh: 从0到1的架构师和构建者，能够胜任全栈开发

paragraphs.en: Comfort talking to customers directly and translating messy domain knowledge into clean product decisions
paragraphs.zh: 能够直接与客户沟通，并将杂乱的领域知识转化为清晰的产品决策

paragraphs.en: Communicate with empathy and honesty. Tell us what makes you happy/unhappy
paragraphs.zh: 以同理心和诚实进行沟通。 告诉我们什么让你开心/不开心

sents.zh: 以同理心和诚实进行沟通。

sents.en: Tell us what makes you happy/unhappy
sents.zh: 告诉我们什么让你开心/不开心

paragraphs.en: Don’t mind schlep . We are regularly knee-deep in schlep
paragraphs.zh: 别嫌麻烦。 我们经常深陷于各种繁琐杂务之中。

sents.en: We are regularly knee-deep in schlep
sents.zh: 我们经常深陷于各种繁琐杂务之中。

paragraphs.en: Have built something people used/paid for (founder/startup)
paragraphs.zh: 打造过有人使用/付费的产品（创始人/创业公司）

paragraphs.en: Bild AI is an early-stage startup with a ton of really difficult technical challenges to solve. We're building blueprint understanding with a model-garden approach, so there is a lots of ground to break. We raised from the top VCs in the world before demo day and have a customer-obsessed approach to product development.
paragraphs.zh: Bild AI 是一家处于早期阶段的初创公司，面临着大量极具挑战性的技术难题需要解决。 我们正在采用模型花园（model-garden）的方法构建图纸理解能力，因此有很多领域等待开拓。 我们在演示日之前就获得了世界顶级风险投资机构的投资，并坚持以客户为中心的产品开发理念。
